groups.name: Heading hierarchy skips levels or out of order
groups.definition: Does the heading outline skip levels or appear out of order (e.g., h2 to h4, h3 before h2, sidebar heading before main heading)?

groups.name: Page lacks an h1 heading
groups.definition: Does the page have no h1 element, with headings starting at h2 or lower?

groups.name: Clean ordered heading hierarchy
groups.definition: Does the page have one h1, h2 section titles and h3 card titles in orderly, shallow hierarchy without skipped levels?

groups.name: Content images have empty alt text
groups.definition: Do content or decorative images (photos, thumbnails, card images) carry empty alt attributes while logos or few others have descriptive alt?

groups.name: All images have alt text
groups.definition: Do all images have alt attributes present, with descriptive or generic text?

groups.name: Semantic landmark elements used
groups.definition: Does the page use semantic landmark elements such as header, nav, main, section and footer?

groups.name: Sparse non-utility semantic class names
groups.definition: Does the markup use few, hand-written semantic class names rather than utility-framework classes?

groups.name: Minimal head metadata, no structured data
groups.definition: Does the head contain only minimal meta tags (charset, viewport, maybe description) and no JSON-LD structured data?

groups.name: Link-dense page with few buttons
groups.definition: Are interactive elements mostly anchors, with many links relative to text and few or no buttons?

groups.name: Address element for contact details
groups.definition: Are contact details marked up with an address element?

groups.name: Quotes use figure and blockquote
groups.definition: Are testimonials or quotes marked up with figure, blockquote and figcaption?

groups.name: Article and time elements for items
groups.definition: Are repeated items such as news posts or cards marked up as article elements, with time elements for dates?

groups.name: Manual line breaks in copy
groups.definition: Does the page use br elements for line breaks in copy or address blocks?

groups.name: Hidden modal dialog with form
groups.definition: Does the page include a hidden modal dialog containing a form such as login?

groups.name: Metric values use b and small elements
groups.definition: Are stat values and labels marked up with b and small elements?

groups.name: Navigation and footer links in lists
groups.definition: Are navigation and footer links marked up as ul/li lists?

groups.name: Brand-plus-tagline page title
groups.definition: Does the page title follow a short brand plus tagline pattern?
